
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(svglite)
library(ggpubr)
```

read in data

```{r}
key.long <- readRDS("../../data/derived/clinical_manuscript.rds")$samples_long
met <- read_excel("../../data/raw/urine-metabolomics/Dan Urine Anthocyanin 11-10-2022.xlsx", sheet = "concentration ng mL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`21-V2`))
```

```{r}
met <- met %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:81, 
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))
  ) %>%
  rename("metabolite" = `...1`) %>%
  separate(Sample, c("Subject.Number", "v")) %>%
  mutate(v = toupper(v))
```

prep key

```{r}
key.long <- key.long %>%
  mutate(v =  toupper(substr(timepoints, 11, 12)),
         v = ifelse(v == "-V", toupper(substr(timepoints, 12, 13)), v),
         Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, v, Timepoint) 

# join to met 
met <- met %>%
  mutate(Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)) %>%
  left_join(key.long, by = c("Subject.Number", "v"))
```

Note: key.long doesn't include participants 84, 101, 102 that are present in metabolomics data Would like to check that the timepoint key includes all participants as it was developed early on...

plot metabolites

```{r}
met$Timepoint <- factor(met$Timepoint, levels=c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"))

met %>%
  filter(!is.na(Timepoint)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(metabolite ~ ., scales = "free_y") +

  theme(base.size = 10) +

```

```{r}
# Ensure correct timepoint order
met$Timepoint <- factor(met$Timepoint, levels = c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"))

# Paired Wilcoxon test (correct way)
wilcox_rb_tb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB), !is.na(tB)) %>%
  group_by(metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    p.value = wilcox.test(rB, tB, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

# Select significant metabolites (use raw p for plotting)
sig_mets <- wilcox_rb_tb %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

# Subset for plotting
met_comp <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% sig_mets)

# Plot
ggplot(met_comp, aes(x = Timepoint, y = value, group = Subject.Number)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Timepoint), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("rB" = "gold", "tB" = "purple")) +
  labs(
    title = "Compliance Check: Metabolite Increase Post BRB",
    y = "ng/mL"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

# Check results
wilcox_rb_tb %>% arrange(p.adj)
length(sig_mets)
```

```{r}
# Get significant metabolite names
sig_metabs <- sig_mets

# Subset original data
rb_tb_data <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% sig_metabs)

rb_tb_wide <- rb_tb_data %>%
  select(metabolite, Subject.Number, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(change = tB - rB)
write.csv(
  rb_tb_wide,
  file = "../../data/derived/rb_tb_wide.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Loop through each metabolite and plot the changes

  print(p)  # shows the plot if interactive
  ggsave(paste0("../../exploratory/figures/", gsub(" ", "_", metab), "_barplot.png"), plot = p, width = 6, height = 4)
}
```

```{r}
# Use same significance definition as above (sig_mets)
met_rb_tb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% sig_mets)

# Create wide format and compute change
met_diff <- met_rb_tb %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB), !is.na(tB)) %>%
  mutate(change = tB - rB)

# Safe plotting
if (nrow(met_diff) == 0) {
  message("No complete rB–tB pairs available for density plot")
} else {
  ggplot(met_diff, aes(x = change)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "(ng/mL)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
}

```

```{r}
heat_data_sig <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Scale each metabolite across participants
heat_data_sig_z <- scale(heat_data_sig)

# Hierarchical clustering on scaled data
row_dist <- dist(heat_data_sig_z)
row_clust <- hclust(row_dist)

# Cut dendrogram into 2 clusters
cluster_assignments <- cutree(row_clust, k = 2)

# Check which cluster has higher polyphenol change
cluster_means <- tapply(
  rowMeans(heat_data_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
  cluster_assignments,
  mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cluster_means

```

```{r}
# Automatically define responder as the cluster with higher mean change
responder_cluster <- as.numeric(names(which.max(cluster_means)))

merged_clusters <- ifelse(
  cluster_assignments == responder_cluster,
  "Responder",
  "Non-responder"
)

# Build responder annotation dataframe
compliance_cluster_df <- data.frame(
  BRB_response = merged_clusters
)

rownames(compliance_cluster_df) <- rownames(heat_data_sig_z)


pheatmap(
  heat_data_sig_z,
  annotation_row = compliance_cluster_df,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("purple4", "white", "red2"))(100)
)
```
```{r}
heat_data_sig <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Scale each metabolite across participants
heat_data_sig_z <- scale(heat_data_sig)

# Create polyphenol response score per participant
score_df <- data.frame(
  pt = rownames(heat_data_sig_z),
  poly_score = rowMeans(heat_data_sig_z, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Define responders using median split
score_df <- score_df %>%
  mutate(
    BRB_response = ifelse(
      poly_score >= median(poly_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      "Responder",
      "Non-responder"
    )
  )

# Build annotation dataframe
compliance_cluster_df <- score_df %>%
  select(pt, BRB_response)

rownames(compliance_cluster_df) <- compliance_cluster_df$pt
compliance_cluster_df <- compliance_cluster_df[, "BRB_response", drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  heat_data_sig_z,
  annotation_row = compliance_cluster_df,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("purple4", "white", "red2"))(100)
)

write.csv(
  compliance_cluster_df,
  file = "../../data/derived/compliance_cluster_df.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# Pick one non-significant metabolite
no_change_met <- wilcox_rb_tb %>%
  filter(p.adj > 0.5) %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% unique(met$metabolite)) %>%
  filter(!metabolite %in% c("cy rut", "cy xyrut")) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

# Set desired facet order
met_order <- c("cy rut", "cy xyrut", no_change_met)

# Plot
met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint, "rB" = "Pre-BRB", "tB" = "Post-BRB"),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)  # enforce facet order
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +  # show individual points
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "ng/mL") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)

ggsave("../../exploratory/figures/metabolomics_3boxplot.svg", height = 4, width = 6)

```

```{r}
# Define comparisons (Pre-BRB vs Post-BRB for each metabolite)
comparisons <- list(c("Pre-BRB", "Post-BRB"))

met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint, "rB" = "Pre-BRB", "tB" = "Post-BRB"),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "(ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons, 
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    label = "p.signif"     # <-- asterisks instead of raw p-values
  )

ggsave("../../exploratory/figures/metabolomics_3boxplot1.svg", height = 4, width = 6)

```

```{r}
comparisons <- list(c("Pre-BRB", "Post-BRB"),c("Pre-Placebo", "Post-Placebo"))

met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB", "rP", "tP"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
                       "rB" = "Pre-BRB",  "tB" = "Post-BRB",
                       "rP" = "Pre-Placebo", "tP" = "Post-Placebo"),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint,
                       levels = c("Pre-Placebo","Post-Placebo","Pre-BRB","Post-BRB")),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "(ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))+
  stat_compare_means(
  comparisons = comparisons,
  method = "wilcox.test",
  method.args = list(paired = TRUE),
  label = "p.signif"
)
ggsave("../figures/fig2E.svg", height = 4, width = 6)
```
